summary_rationale: Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd demonstrates high-quality, asset-light compounding across FY22-FY26: consolidated sales grew from Rs 424 Cr (FY22) to Rs 1,253 Cr (FY26), net profit expanded from Rs 127 Cr to Rs 397 Cr, AUM scaled from Rs 32,906 Cr to Rs 93,037 Cr (and Rs 1,08,377 Cr by Sep 2026), and ROCE/ROE sit at 59.2%/47.3% with minimal debt and a healthy 30.7% average dividend payout. Regret RM attrition remains below 1% and client attrition near 1%, supported by an internal Account Manager-to-RM grooming pipeline. However, kpi_health is rated PASS_WITH_WATCH rather than an unqualified PASS due to three structural watch items: (1) 28% AUM reliance on structured products / Non-PPMLDs with group-NBFC issuer concentration in Anand Rathi Global Finance Ltd (ARGFL) and post-Finance Act 2023 slab-rate taxation; (2) Q4 FY26-Q2 FY27 headline P&L distortion from ARWL ESOP-2025 charges (compressing reported OPM from 47% to 29-34%) alongside Rs 207 Cr TTM Other Income fair-value gains; and (3) gradual promoter stake dilution from 48.20% (Dec 2023) to 40.95% (Sep 2026).
